core_obligations: Cech vanishing (proof lines 8157-8162): for any covering of an object V the Cech cohomology of f_*I vanishes in positive degrees, because f_*I is computed by sections of I over the base change and I is injective.

Acyclicity (proof lines 8162-8169): the vanishing of those Cech groups, together with the criterion of the same chapter, gives that f_*I is acyclic for the functor Gamma(V, -) and for the pushforward along any further morphism g.
proof_roadmap: Show the Cech cohomology of the pushforward of an injective sheaf vanishes in positive degrees.
Apply the acyclicity criterion to the sections functor and to a further pushforward.
difficulty_reason: The lemma verifies the acyclicity needed for the Leray spectral sequence: for an injective abelian sheaf I on X_etale and an object V of Y_etale, the pushforward f_*I has vanishing Cech cohomology, is acyclic for the sections functor at V, and is acyclic for the pushforward along any further morphism (statement lines 8145-8155). The proof establishes the Cech vanishing for coverings of V (proof lines 8157-8162) and then applies the acyclicity criterion of the same chapter in the two remaining cases (proof lines 8162-8169). The non-formal content is the Cech computation for the pushforward of an injective sheaf. The claim is H2: one vanishing computation plus one criterion.
